g.text: 1 // The project board: open pull requests and issues, …
Reference: briareus-windows. Other clients match this structure, differing only as noted here.

The layout is two columns when the content is at least 720px wide: the tree takes 28% of the width (240 to 340px) and stays in view while the file scrolls. Below 720px the tree stacks above the open tabs and the file.

The finder's cue text follows the mode: Go to class (Ctrl+N), Go to file (Ctrl+Shift+N), Go to symbol (Ctrl+Shift+Alt+N), Find in files (Ctrl+Shift+F). Results replace the tree while a query is typed.
The branch menu lists 'Default branch (main)' first, then the other branches. Right-clicking a file tab offers Close, Close others, Close all and Copy path.
Empty and edge states: 'No file open — Pick a file in the tree, or press Ctrl+P and type a few letters of its name.', 'This file is too large to show', 'This file is binary', 'This file is empty.'
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
